output.summary: An annual herb native to most of Europe, northern Africa and much of Asia, it grows on cultivated or disturbed ground. Its single upright stem branches near the top and bears small yellow-green flowers from mid-spring to late summer. The raw plant is poisonous and may cause nausea, vomiting, allergic reactions or skin irritation.
